component.description: Component (e.g. 'local_myplugin'), path relative to the Moodle root (e.g. 'local/myplugin'), or absolute path

output_dir.description: Directory to write the ZIP into (defaults to the current working directory; must already exist)

strict.description: Validate moodle.org plugin directory submission requirements before packaging; refuses to build the ZIP if any fail (default: false, package unconditionally)
